card.name: Punctuation after morning in dose schedules
card.fires_on: The comma, 'and' or 'mg' right after 'morning' or 'breakfast' in a list of daily dose times, where midday, afternoon or lunch comes next.

modes.label: Comma after morning or breakfast
modes.description: A comma follows the first time-of-day item in a list of dose times.
modes.example: (at least 4 hours apart, e.g., morning<<,>> mid-day, and evening)

modes.label: 'and' after morning
modes.description: The word 'and' joins morning to evening meals in a twice-daily schedule.
modes.example: twice daily with the morning<< and>> evening meals.

modes.label: Partway through a time list
modes.description: A unit or word-part inside a schedule that is about to name the midday or afternoon slot.
modes.example: (e.g., 300 mg a.m., 300<< mg>> early p.m. and 20
